reference.title: Product A: Common Adverse Reactions
reference.shortdesc: Summary of clinical trial and post-marketing common adverse reactions observed with Product A.

section.title: Summary of Common Adverse Reactions for Product A
section.p: Clinically common adverse reactions occurred in ≥ 5% of patients of Product A include:

ul.li: Neutropenia: Reported in 68% of patients across all grades (32% Grade 3–4).
Fatigue: Reported in 54% of patients across all grades (8% Grade 3–4).
Nausea and Vomiting: Reported in 42% of patients across all grades (4% Grade 3–4).
Thrombocytopenia: Reported in 28% of patients across all grades (12% Grade 3–4).

section.title: Internal Review Notes
section.p: These notes are intended for internal regulatory review and should not be included in patient-facing materials.
Adverse reaction data is based on clinical trial populations; post-marketing surveillance may yield additional insights.
Ensure that all adverse reaction frequencies are updated in accordance with the latest clinical trial data and post-marketing reports.
